title: The knot's three-fold spaces are built from the Fano plane
claim: For a connected cubic triple system H (n points, n lines of three points, every point on three lines, lines may repeat): (1) H is not 2-colourable iff it is minimally not 2-colourable iff its incidence matrix is sign-nonsingular (|det| = per > 0) iff every nice cycle of its incidence graph has length 2 mod 4 iff the 2-in 2-out digraph of any perfect matching has no even directed cycle (Seymour's linear-algebra argument; Bassett-Maybee-Quirk). (2) Nontrivial tight cuts of the incidence graph are 3-edge cuts whose two contractions are again cubic; perfect-matching signs factorize across the cut, so H is not 2-colourable iff both pieces are sign-nonsingular up to one common twist (one complemented incidence at the contracted vertex), and an untwisted non-colourable piece acts as a single point or line. (3) Hence Fano compositions (point and line splices; every n = 7 + 6k) are not 2-colourable, and by the duality of SPACE-SELECTION-20261030-001C the knot has three-fold spaces with 7 + 6k triangles for every k, obtained by substituting Fano gadgets into triangles or contacts (lambda(0) = 5^(k+1) on the checked ones). (4) Every non-colourable H is a Fano composition if no cubic brace has a sign-nonsingular signing with exactly one negative edge; McCuaig's theorem (F7 is the only strongly 2-connected digraph without even dicycles) settles the untwisted brace case, and the one-twist case is proved for the Heawood graph and for planar cubic braces (at least six nice 4-faces against at most two fixed by one edge). (5) The premise that the Fano plane is the only non-colourable cubic triple system is false: the 13-point Fano splice is linear and not 2-colourable. (6) A gadget all of whose contacts are two-fold phase locks or three-fold contacts of odd base count has no locks: the base and non-base slot counts force it, so the planned mixed gluings do not exist.
failure_conditions: A connected cubic triple system on which the stated equivalences disagree.
A splice whose matching signs do not factorize, or a Fano composition that is 2-colourable.
A dual gadget of a Fano composition that is not exact at the knot.
A single negated incidence making the Heawood graph sign-nonsingular.
A gadget of locks and odd three-fold contacts that contains a lock.
foundation_claim_scope: Cubic 3-uniform hypergraphs (triple systems), their incidence matrices and digraphs; the three-fold odd gadgets of SPACE-SELECTION and the signed not-all-equal knot at the knot angle. The general classification is conditional on the stated one-twist lemma.

validation.status: checked: equivalences on Fano compositions and 300 random cubic systems; matching-sign factorization on two splices; compositions with 7 to 49 points non-colourable; dual gadgets with 7, 13, 19 triangles exact at the knot; one-twist lemma on the Heawood graph and two planar examples; mixed-gluing identity on all gadgets with n <= 5; controls fire; no human or external review
validation.novelty: classical inputs: Seymour 1974 (linear-algebra argument), Bassett-Maybee-Quirk (sign-nonsingularity and even cycles), tight cuts (Lovasz), Robertson-Seymour-Thomas 1999, McCuaig 2000; no overlap found (candidate local delta) for the sign-twist splice calculus and the reduction in this setting, and for the reading as the knot's three-fold spaces
validation.independence: Written by Claude in one session at the repository owner's request on 2026-10-30.
